'''Yannick Lapointe MKOS DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-11955">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11955 DeckTech post 11955], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 23 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11955/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11955/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018092438/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11955/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]]
* '''Published:''' 23 November 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 MKOS Lapointe DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits the new site, beolo, cc guys that convert site, new jp site, another 1/0 crappy jp site, do or do not, when you shoot a bh gun you add 1 destiny, grabbler: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' this deck will @#$% slap you to death

The post also lists 1x the new site, 1x beolo, 1x cc guys that convert site, 1x new jp site, 1x another 1/0 crappy jp site, 1x do or do not, 2x when you shoot a bh gun you add 1 destiny, 2x grabbler, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.
